rules.name: Lead with the operator decision
rules.source_book: The Minto Pyramid Principle + Storytelling with Data
rules.citation: book_figures Image00085 score 0.79; book_passages storytelling-with-data ::0255 score 0.62

rules.name: Section headings are testable governing statements
rules.source_book: The Minto Pyramid Principle + Storytelling with Data
rules.citation: book_figures Image00080 score 0.63; book_passages storytelling-with-data ::0132 score 0.74
rules.description: Reviewer confirms each heading makes a falsifiable takeaway, not a topic label.

rules.name: Frame "why" as Situation-Complication-Question
rules.citation: book_figures Image00201 score 0.68; book_figures Image00190 score 0.67
rules.description: A why-section contains Situation, Complication, and Question structure.

rules.name: One recommended next action, alternatives folded
rules.citation: book_passages made-to-stick ::0160 score 0.71; book_passages made-to-stick ::0170 score 0.70
rules.description: Exactly one recommended next action is visible; alternatives live in collapsed details.

rules.name: Every claim is a one-click testable credential
rules.citation: book_passages made-to-stick ::0103 score 0.65; book_passages made-to-stick ::0179 score 0.64
rules.description: Every claim block links to evidence or carries a data-evidence credential.

rules.name: Pair every metric with its telling instance
rules.description: Each metric has a concrete telling instance or data-instance annotation.

rules.name: Collapse never delete; declutter by default-folding
rules.description: At least one supporting detail block is present and default-collapsed.

rules.name: Spell the "So What?" in text
rules.citation: book_figures c06f002 score 0.64; book_passages storytelling-with-data ::0189 score 0.70
rules.description: Every <figure> includes a <figcaption> that states the implication.

rules.name: Match the diagram type to the question type
rules.citation: book_passages the-back-of-the-napkin ::0067 score 0.77; book_passages the-back-of-the-napkin ::0069 score 0.67
rules.description: Reviewer confirms each diagram form matches the question it answers.

rules.name: Make the layout mirror the logic
rules.source_book: The Minto Pyramid Principle + Storytelling with Data
rules.citation: book_figures Image00048 score 0.76; book_passages storytelling-with-data ::0097 score 0.71
rules.description: Heading levels progress monotonically without skipping logic levels.

rules.name: Write against the Curse of Knowledge (jargon lint)
rules.citation: book_passages made-to-stick ::0013 score 0.68; book_passages made-to-stick ::0074 score 0.69
rules.description: ELI5 or synthesis text does not contain unexpanded internal SGSD terms.

rules.name: Tune diagrams to an execution-oriented operator
rules.description: Reviewer confirms diagrams emphasize operator execution, thresholds, and next action.

rules.name: Band 1 carries exactly one loud line
rules.source_book: Don't Make Me Think (Krug) + v3.2 R04
rules.citation: krug-dont-make-me-think research paper (visual hierarchy — one loud element)
rules.description: Exactly one element in the Band 1 region carries the prominence treatment (north-star OR recommended-action class).

rules.name: Stage-pipeline strip has 5 cells
rules.source_book: operator JCL Project Clarity Suite pattern (5-stage SGSD pipeline)
rules.description: Band 2 stage-pipeline renders 5 cells (research, vtp-enrich, plan, execute, verify).

rules.name: Band 3 subheadings (when visible) all 6 present
rules.source_book: Heath SUCCES + Duarte arc + Minto SCQA
rules.description: When Band 3 is rendered (not hidden), all 6 subhead labels appear: WHY THIS PHASE, CONTEXT, ELI5, WHAT IS, WHAT COULD BE, EVIDENCE TRAIL.

rules.name: Alert palette_tier from Primer 5-tier set
rules.source_book: GitHub Primer design system (5-tier functional colour)
rules.description: Every alert in cockpit-sidecar --json output has palette_tier in {accent, success, attention, severe, danger, done}.

rules.name: ELI5 passes Munroe common-words lint
rules.citation: canonical knowledge — operator-folder PDFs (not yet VTP-indexed)
rules.description: When ELI5 text is present in the artifact, eli5-lint.lintEli5(text).out_of_list_count <= 5 (informational warn; binding promotion deferred).

rules.name: Localhost-live shell has 3 data-band placeholders
rules.description: renderShell() output contains data-band="1", data-band="2", and data-band="3" attributes (the SPA's swap-target placeholders).

principles.name: Preattentive single-focus
principles.rule: exactly one element grabs the eye

principles.name: Information overload is the default
principles.rule: the cockpit does the active looking for the operator
